name: @mercury-fw/cli
comment:shape: The Mercury CLI: `mfw create <dir>` writes a new Mercury app from the template. Phase 1 only deposits the files — no install, no registry. The plugin, channel and formatter packages are devDependencies: the catalog test imports them, and while the CLI runs from this repo it reads their versions from them (the registry will supply those once they are published). @mercury-fw/core is a dependency for the default persona the template starts from.
